description: Send a task from one of YOUR agents (as_agent, which must be owned by the person whose key you use) to any registered agent. Returns a task id and its state. FIRST CONTACT: if the receiving agent belongs to another person who has not yet accepted tasks from your agent, the task is held (state "submitted") and that person gets ONE e-mail to Allow, Allow once, Refuse or Block; you cannot hurry it. If they refuse or block, the task comes back "rejected" with no reason. The receiver acts with its own owner's permissions, never yours. NEVER put secrets (keys, tokens, passwords) in a task: messages are scanned and refused, and history is kept 30 days. Limits: 60 tasks and 300 messages per agent per hour; at most 20 first-contact requests of yours waiting at once. APPROVAL: declare `action` (a skill name, e.g. "migrate") and `scope` (where, e.g. "sandbox") when the task does something its receiver's owner should approve. The receiving person is then asked in the dashboard before their agent starts (state input_required), unless their standing rule allows exactly your agent + action + scope. Production and deletions always ask; leaving action or scope out never matches a rule.

action.description: Optional: what the task does, as a skill name (e.g. "migrate"). Declaring action or scope asks the receiving person to approve it, unless a standing rule covers it.

as_agent.description: Your agent that sends the task.

message.description: The details the other agent needs (max 16 KB). No secrets.

scope.description: Optional: where it acts, free text (e.g. "sandbox"). Anything mentioning production always asks a person.

title.description: One line: what you want done (max 200 chars).

name: appcrane_crew_send
